notes.title: Version 1.0.4.1
notes.content:
[b]UI Fixes[/b]
 [list]
[*]    Improved intro and outro.
[*]     Modified unique quest characters in start towns.
[*]     Minor modifications to quest start lines.
[*]     Added statistics for each party member upon game completion, including kills, deaths, damage, etc.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
   [list]
[*]  Added voices for some quests.
[*]     Added voice for intro and outro.
[*]     Soundbomb has even more lowered volume.
[/list]

[b]User Interface and Quality of Life[/b]
   [list]
[*]  Close popups that can be closed with order walk.
[*]     ESC button properly closes popups.
[*]     Chat panel is closed from start in singleplayer.
[*]     Reverted background image in the main menu.
[/list]

[b]Character and Items Adjustments[/b]
 [list]
[*]    Demon now has minus cold resistance.
[*]     Warlock cloak now requires the Warlock class.
[*]     Removed the Mindstun spell for rework.
[*]     Hexlore Magic School no longer visible under skills for all characters.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
   [list]
[*]  Timer is now synced in multiplayer correctly.
[*]     Fixed bug with timer resetting.
[*]     Fixed bug where Chaos Dwarves had a unique shield they shouldn't have.
[*]     Fixed bug where heroes placed in keeps were multiplying and breaking the game.
[*]     Dark Lord's shield is now unique (can't spawn multiple of it).
[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*]     "Three Kings" Achievement now unlocks Warlock.
[*]     Achievements that unlock specific characters do so retrospectively when the player starts up the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     Fixed a small bug with quest state on a saved game.
[*]     "Nice try!" Achievement now correctly measures required henchmen after battle; achievement texts updated.
[*]     Player count now accurately reflects players in room rather than all online players.
[*]     Companions that spawned on load while in player's party are now fixed.
[*]     Holy stone no longer clones itself.
[*]     Corrected resource cost when buying multiple henchmen.
[*]     Fixed issue where selling items and shop could remove holy stone unintentionally.
[*]     Improved the functionality of forging, especially when adding various items.
[*]     Saving items Keeps works properly and it now also store heroes.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay and Balancing[/b]

[list]
[*]     Implemented pause during saving to prevent quitting mid-save.
[*]     Notification for failed saves ("Save failed" message).
[*]     Added easy, hard, and insane difficulty modes.
[*]     New players no longer receive hard-to-play characters initially.
[*]     Added game setting to enable/disable the imp.
[*]     Added achievements for hard, insane, hardcore, normal, and easy modes.
[*]     Henchmen are now immune to curses.
[*]     Trading negative gold is no longer possible.
[*]     Enhanced monks' ki abilities.
[/list]

[b]Character and Enemy Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*]     Enhanced mind control to prioritize heroes.
[*]     Restored Chaos Dragon's fireball functionality.    
[*]     Introduced big spider companion for goblin ranger as a level-up option, requiring spider companion first.
[*]     Added Hard hit ability to warriors.
[*]     Introduced Barbarian ability for return damage in Defensive Berserk (You can now build a tanky Thorn Barbarian if you want).
[*]     Added Werewolf as a playable character (Can be unlocked with Achievement).
[*]     Introduced Warlock Class.
[/list]

[b]User Interface and Quality of Life[/b]

[list]
[*]     Added short intro and outro.
[*]     Improved clarity of text for abilities and items.
[*]     Increased winning gold requirement in player list UI from 500k to 800k.
[*]     Corrected alignment text in hero selection.
[*]     Added quest location hints for early quests.
[*]     Enhanced property descriptions (str, agi, int, etc.) in hero picking screen.
[*]     Increased font sizes where needed.
[*]     Reworked Hero selection screen for better focus on character backgrounds.
[*]     Added background history for many characters.
[*]     Game starts with a more zoomed-out view.
[*]     Updated Steam connection failure text.
[*]     Moved level-up screen to the right for better inventory visibility.
[*]     Added hardcore game-over announcement.
[*]     Removed the connected from chat message when starting the game.
[*]     Extended timer in multiplayer hero selection lobby.
[/list]

[b]Items[/b]

[list]
[*]     Gloves of speed now increase reload time for crossbows and rifles.
[*]     Clarified differences between knuckles and knives.
[*]     Dropping all Gems in a Holy Shrine now yields a Holy Stone.
[*]     Introduced a new Holy Stone recipe using gems.
[*]     Reworked shields for more distinct variations.
[*]     Added Warlock Items: Staffs and robes.
[*]     Introduced an item set focusing on damage return.
[*]     Renamed Amulet of Peace to Amulet of Harmony; now damages barbarians.
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]

[list]
[*]     Added soundbomb avoidance (previously, mass heal caused excessive noise).
[*]     Introduced an option to toggle affirmative sounds.
[*]     Improved animal sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 (Hotfix)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Holy Stone no longer disappears in Town.
[*] Resolved a bug related to returning quests with specific Boss kill requirements.
[*] Introduced an additional method for gaining access to towers.
[*] Fixed the spelling in the achievement "A Demons' Journey.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]UI and Graphics Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]   Updated ability images for landscape modifiers.
[*]     Improved UI images for forest, desert, and snow travel guides ability.
[*]     Enhanced defensive mode text for clarity.
[*]     Updated Drow UI images.
[*]     Revised Bookworm and Sailing Race character UI images.
[*]     New UI image for Master Blacksmith, matching the Forge's style.
[*]     Moved Save Panel UI to the center to ensure the new save button is fully visible.
[*]     Adjusted Recipe Panel for improved visibility during forging.
[*]     Updated UI for Human Henchmen Militia.
[*]     Added text in multiplayer UI to remind players to select the correct network region.
[*]     Updated Travel Speed spelling.
[*]     Renamed the hat "Eastern Gem" for clarity.
[*]     Corrected text in the Nemund quest about the bell at Greagobhar.
[*]     Updated text for "Burn Down Town" achievement.
[*]     Changed tooltip text when picking up Tears.
[*]     Corrected "Demon's Journey" achievement text.
[*]     Updated and corrected spelling for Race, Class, and Alignment texts.
[*]     General text spelling fixes.
[*]     Added permanent wound information.
[*]     Spelling of HP regeneration.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]

    [list]
[*]     Enabled clicking on both UI icon circle and 3D model on the map for easier navigation, especially for new players.
[*] Updated the Undead Warrior companion in the crypt.
[*]     Quests requiring the defeat of a boss that is already dead will no longer be available.
[*]     Removed the Mage Guild certificate to decrease backpack item requirements (entry to towers now requires at least one gnome).
[*]     Improved healers in cities on the evil side.
[*]     Increased affirmative sound cooldown timer for character walking.
[*]     Added Hardcore game mode.
[*]     New achievement for winning the game in Hardcore mode.
[*]     Added the ability to decline the imp and kick him in singleplayer.
[*]     Added "Small Size" ability to gnomes, making them harder to target.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

    [list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Wood Elf quest duplicates "Tree of Life".
[*]     Abilities now displayed correctly in special locations on the map, e.g., blacksmith.
[*]     Adjusted swimming skeletons to remain on land.
[*]     Implemented a fix for the bug where players get stuck in events ("You found a chest").
[*]     Reworked logic for saving items in keeps, ensuring compatibility with older saves (note: items from older saves will not appear in keeps).
[*]     Fixed the Merchant Achievement not connecting properly to Steam.
[*]     Fixed issues for players with long Steam names starting the game.
[*]     Fixed issue with forging items and related achievements.
[*]     Corrected Mynith the dragon's animations and reclassified it as a dragon, not undead.
[*]     Fixed a bug preventing some locations from spawning (Lost City, Demonic Temple, etc.).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1 (Hotfix)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]     Respawn Point Persistence: Respawn points are now correctly saved and persistent across game sessions.
[*]     Keep item saves are now saved correctly
[*]     Forge Mechanism: Improved the forging process. Items that are not being used during crafting will no longer disappear.
[*]     HP Regeneration is now correctly spelled
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.0
notes.content:
[b]General Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] 
[*]     Map button label updated to "M" from "V".
[*]     Corrected tooltip information for supply items.
[*]     Race tooltip display issues fixed.
[*]     Spelling corrections for "Goblin", "Great Sword", and "Movement Speed".
[*]     Clarified text regarding cures for Curse.
[*]     Renamed "Weapon Club" to "Club".
[*]     Enhanced clarity in damage descriptions at the start of battles from items and abilities.
[*]     Updated help section: Respawn key changed from F12 to F10.
[*]     Corrected the Highelf boss name in achievements and quests.
[*]     Spelling correction in "Holy Grail".
[*]     Improved description for "Imp's Unwanted" quest.
[*]     Corrected spelling in "Eternal Justice" recipe and other recipes.
[*]     Enhanced explanations of main stats.
[*]     Clarified and corrected "Attack Speed" description, including its application (melee, ranged, or all).
[*]     Corrected the spelling of "Witch Hut".
[*]     Renamed "Poor Horse" to "Donkey".
[/list]

[b]Achievements:[/b]

[list]
[*]     Fixed issue where some in-game secret achievements were not secret on Steam.
[*]     Resolved issue where completing the Warrior achievement also completed the Ranger achievement.
[*]     Corrected text for the Holy achievement on Steam.
[*]     Updated "Unlock Character" achievement text to "Alignment Race Class".
[*]     Adjusted character unlocks to correspond with their proper achievements.
[*]     Updated description for the Dragon Slayer achievement.
[*]     Addressed issue where achievements sometimes failed to save.
[/list]

UI Enhancements:

[list]
[*]     Improved readability of the Permawound healing UI.
[*]     Added a Discord link to the main menu.
[*]     Ability display now available when visiting the Ice Altar.
[/list]

[b]Item Updates:[/b]

   [list]
[*]  Changed the image for the "Tears of Adria" item.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

    [list]
[*] Fixed bug where players wouldn't lose gold when purchasing with a full backpack.
[*]     Resolved issue with duplicate player names in PlayFab preventing game startup.
[*]     Addressed rare bug of character invisibility at the start of multiplayer games.
[*]     Fixed bug causing a random character start when replaying with the same character.
[*]     "Undead Army / Undead Master" now functions correctly with an improved description.
[*]     "Desert Gem" no longer spawns in undead chests in the desert.
[*]     Abilities acquired from estates now function correctly in multiplayer.
[*]     Crafting in common or master forge no longer removes unused items.
[*]     Addressed issue where all races could rebuild certain Lumbermills.
[*]     Fixed the invisible chest bug (please report if encountered).
[*]     Resolved multiplayer event-related starting bug.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]

   [list]
[*]  Monastery now replenishes new defense troops and recruits.
[*]     Imp now only spawns in multiplayer games.
[*]     Undead characters no longer receive quests to kill undead.
[*]     Changed defensive mode time limit from 260 to 340 game seconds.
[*]     Adjusted achievement rewards: If a character is already unlocked, players receive a random character instead.
[/list]

[b]Save and Load Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*]     Save game function now tracks quest progress, kills, etc.
[*]     Corrected gold display on game load (visual bug).
[*]     Items stored in keeps are now preserved in saved games.
[/list]
